  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-q6vu7r",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop at the receiving header (P-R) occurred within a system where Utilities distributes air to RHOB. The event is consistent with an interruption in that distribution path.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["n-ax2alr", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the distribution path had been isolated or blocked upstream, a pressure drop at P-R would still occur; if it were not serving RHOB, no drop would be seen there.",
      "competingExplanation": "An interruption could have occurred downstream of P-R (e.g., valve closure), but evidence does not confirm this. The supported condition is that the gallery serves RHOB and a pressure drop was observed at its receiving header.","evidenceGap": "The exact point of interruption (source, distribution line, or local valve) remains unknown; no record identifies which specific component failed or changed state."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-q6vu7r",
      "toKey": "n-ai1z7r",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The area directory is a location index and does not establish valve positions or pressure availability. This limitation means the crew could not rely on it to confirm current supply conditions.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the directory had established valve positions and pressure availability, it would have provided a reliable reference for crew decisions.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a documented limitation of the record type itself.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence shows whether alternative records (piping diagrams, field observations) were used to verify current conditions."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1q7qtf5",
      "toKey": "n-q6vu7r",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at the time of notification, indicating that boundary preparation had not been formally released. This condition allowed work to proceed under incomplete authorization.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the boundary had been formally released (signature present), work would have proceeded under accepted conditions, potentially reducing exposure to unverified hazards.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a procedural state directly recorded in the evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether informal communication compensated for the missing signature."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-3ykejq",
      "toKey": "n-q6vu7r",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The daily briefing contained no valve-by-valve content, limiting the crew's situational awareness regarding specific supply paths and potential changes.",

      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the briefing had included valve-by-valve content, crew awareness of current supply conditions would have been higher.",

      "evidenceGap": "No evidence shows whether verbal briefings or other sources filled this gap."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1b1mn9d",
      "toKey": "n-q6vu7r",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "No evidence confirms whether the crew saw recent changes or used a different version of equipment-location sheets. This uncertainty increases risk if an unrecorded change affected supply routing.",

      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had seen recent changes, they might have adjusted their understanding of supply paths accordingly.",

      "rationale": "Maintenance receiver M-A had boundary acceptance pending at shift start, indicating that the work area was not yet formally released for maintenance activities.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If boundary acceptance had been completed, the work area would have been formally released with verified conditions.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a documented procedural state.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record shows whether informal coordination compensated for pending formal release."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1675uru",
      "toKey": "n-q6vu7r",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The Utilities air gallery normally shows a normal pressure band (~6.8–6.9 bar) at P-R, establishing baseline conditions against which the drop was measured.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the normal band had been lower, a drop to below 4.5 bar might not have triggered an alarm.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a documented baseline condition.","evidenceGap": "No record shows whether transient fluctuations or measurement errors contributed to the observed drop."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-gybvj2",

  ],"decision":{"summary":"The incident involved an instrument-air pressure drop at RHOB receiving header P-R, triggering alarm AL-44 and pausing work. Supported conditions include: (1) the Utilities air gallery serves RHOB; (2) normal pressure band is ~6.8–6.9 bar; (3) alarm activates below 4.5 bar; (4) maintenance acceptance was pending; (5) daily briefing lacked valve-by-valve content.
